metricInterpretation.preloadPartition: preloadAnalyzeMs + preloadRpcOutsideAnalyzeMs + preloadOtherMs equals preloadWallMs; these are non-overlapping categories. preloadOther includes bookkeeping, parser-uncovered CPU, and idle; it is not all CPU.
metricInterpretation.rpcActive: Union time when any preload RPC is active; it can overlap analyzer time. preloadRpcWhileAnalyzeMs reports that overlap.
metricInterpretation.fsCallTotals: fsOperations per-path queueMs/coreMs/wallMs and aggregated fsCallSum are sums across calls. Per-call queue wait sums overlap across requests; do not treat queue/core sum as wall or critical-path time. coreMs is awaited OPFS/API service time, not pure CPU.
metricInterpretation.instrumentation: benchmark:true metrics and timings are diagnostic; compare normal-mode repeat separately. All raw samples and per-path data are preserved under instrumented.

postOptimizationEvidence.change: FSCore caches a bounded chain of resolved directory handles and reuses the common ancestor prefix for subsequent paths; it caches no file handles or file content. Mutations invalidate the chain generation, and stale in-flight traversals cannot replace it.
postOptimizationEvidence.timing: Four raw samples for each of six cases were collected in normal mode, opt-in instrumented mode, then normal mode again. No tests or builds ran during timing. Normal-mode repeats are kept separate; caches persisted. Instrumented per-operation queue/core/wall data is retained in the raw samples. Queue/core totals are call-sums and not additive wall-time components; the preload categories form a non-overlap partition within each sample.
